name: Fitness & Athleisure
tagline: Strong, active and camera-ready: gym, run, yoga and more.
description: Energetic fitness photos for coaches, athletes and anyone proud of their training: barbell lifts, sunrise runs, yoga, boxing, cycling, climbing, pilates and city athleisure. Dramatic gym light and real motion, always in proper training clothes with no logos.
